text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Sorry, sorry! I ended up running completely late!
choice_data_list: To be this late, where and what were you—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Um... it was my fault!
Epi-san couldn't bear to leave me while I was feeling down,
so she took me out to all sorts of places.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Because I felt it was the right thing to do.
Plus, I had a push from the 'Voice of Destiny'!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Still, being late is being late.
I'm so sorry! I will make sure
this never happens again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Given the circumstances, I couldn't be too harsh on her...
I simply reminded her to contact me
if she was going to be late.
